analysis.title: Less Fed fear, same bond problem
key_insights: Softer PCE has reduced Fed hike fear: October hike odds fell from about 45% to 37%.
The long end has not responded. The 30-year yield remains around 5.64%, so the front-end dovish repricing has given little relief to long duration and financial conditions are not easing.
The 2-year is around 4.89% while the 30-year is near 5.64%. The long end sold off faster and the gap widened sharply.
2s30s has re-steepened from roughly 50bp to 75bp as long yields rose faster than the front end. It remains well below the August extreme near 113bp.
MOVE is back around 110 after the latest spike while VIX is near 16. Equities are absorbing the rates shock well while bond uncertainty stays elevated.
If growth weakens while the long end stays high, equities could face softer earnings expectations without the usual valuation cushion from lower rates.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Market-implied odds of an October hike fell after softer PCE, reducing front-end Fed fear.
Long-end yields stay high despite the front-end dovish repricing, which keeps financial conditions tight.
The front end is pricing less Fed threat while the long end still demands more compensation.
The curve has re-steepened because long yields rose faster than the front end. The August extreme was near 113bp.

risk_factors: The long end stays stubbornly high while growth weakens, leaving equities with lower earnings expectations and no valuation relief from falling rates.
Less Fed fear may not bring long yields down, so equities may get less relief than investors expect.
vol_and_positioning: MOVE is back around 110 after the latest spike.
The equity-bond vol divergence has recurred lately: equities absorb the rates shock while bond uncertainty stays elevated.

tension_points.bull_case: Softer PCE lowered October hike odds from about 45% to 37%, taking some Fed fear out of the market.
tension_points.bear_case: The 30-year remains around 5.64% and the curve is steepening, so lower Fed fear is not easing financial conditions. Equities may get less relief than expected.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A fall in long-end yields that brings the long end down alongside the front end would invalidate the bear case.
